scope: Seven-role EnergyPlus construction library and evidence review. No soil model, no whole-building calibration, no forced age or climate multipliers.
baseline: original_typical_fabric; reviewed assumptions are not measurements
basement_decision: Remove unsupported soft-board lining; retain structural family; 15 mm mineral plaster is a representative finish, not a measured BETSI thickness. Missing Office/School roles use optional 200 mm concrete plus 15 mm mineral plaster. Retain across states; no excavation assumed.
ground_values: Retain legacy effective values for API compatibility. Add independently calculated nominal layer U to evidence metadata. Neither establishes building-specific soil heat loss.
climate: 240 matched TABULA comparisons equal; factor 1.0 is no evidenced differentiation, not a physical claim.
modern: SE.06 remains a broad representative extension; no claim that a selected original recipe represents every building from 2006 onward.
infiltration: Retain effective background ACH; no substitution from BETSI ventilation/total air exchange and no n50 conversion.
uncertainty: Qualitative evidence limits, not invented confidence intervals.
rejected_alternatives: 50 mm soft-board basement lining accepted solely from BETSI wood-wool codes
Era inferred from structure or FH identifier
Missing renovation year interpreted as unrenovated
Climate U multiplier inferred from energy limits
Artificial insulation chosen to fit soil-effective U

sources.use: verified MF thermal categories, not exact products
unweighted observed family plausibility, not original-era calibration
moisture and organic lining applicability, not dimensions
reviewed literature recipes, material proxies and independent renovation inventories retained where not contradicted
